items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when you saw Boot, that really messed you up

ctx.x: I learned how to dance, you know. I did my tap dancing, you dig? So I learned how to keep that cymbal going and in the meantime I learned how to do the left and the foot, you know, (musical sounds), play all the licks.
So you were learning all this before you saw Boot because you said when you saw Boot, that really messed you up, but you had already heard some of that change because, you know, this is what -­
